description: This file is a Perl module script that defines a class for handling GET requests within the Coocook project. It provides methods to initialize with options, validate input, and execute a GET request to a specified URI, printing the response body.

classes.name: Coocook::Script::Get
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the logic for executing a GET request and printing the response body, with attributes for command-line arguments and the URI path.

methods.name: new_with_options
methods.description: Initializes the object with command-line options, validates that exactly one URI path argument is provided, and sets the path attribute.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Performs the GET request to the specified URI, enabling internal server error page output for deployment, and prints the response body.
